id: \bI see you beat my disciples. But are you prepared for me?
en: \bI see you beat my disciples. But are you prepared for me?
it: \bVedo che hai battuto i miei allievi. Ma sei pronto ad affrontare me?

id: \bYou did incredible. Please take this as a reward.
en: \bYou did incredible. Please take this as a reward.
it: \bSei stato incredibile. Ti prego, accetta questo come ricompensa.

id: \bYou are too powerful. Go elsewhere to train.
en: \bYou are too powerful. Go elsewhere to train.
it: \bSei troppo forte. Va' ad allenarti altrove.

id: \rBea: Hello there, Trainer of Pikachu. I see you've arrived for our battle.
en: \rBea: Hello there, Trainer of Pikachu. I see you've arrived for our battle.
it: \rBea: Salve, Allenatore di Pikachu. Vedo che sei arrivato per la nostra lotta.

id: \rKnow that my aim is to defeat Leon. Because of that, I won't let someone like you stop me.
en: \rKnow that my aim is to defeat Leon. Because of that, I won't let someone like you stop me.
it: \rSappi che il mio obiettivo è sconfiggere Dandel. Per questo, non permetterò a uno come te di fermarmi.

id: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 930.
en: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 930.
it: Rotom Phone: In base alle tue prestazioni, ora sei al posto 930 in classifica.

id: \rBea: That was quite the battle. Continue to train.
en: \rBea: That was quite the battle. Continue to train.
it: \rBea: È stata una bella lotta. Continua ad allenarti.
